experiment: Phase 7, Stage 2 - last-position additive decoder-direction steering

config.intervention: modified_residual[:, -1, :] += strength * normalized_decoder_direction (last token position only)
config.strength_calibration: strength = multiple * activation_reference * decoder_norm, where activation_reference is the feature's own p99 (or p95-of-active) activation on held-out text
neutral_prompts: My favorite thing to do on the weekend is
Yesterday I went to the store and
The most important skill in life is
When I think about the future, I
Here is a short story about a dog:
config.candidate_selection_data: Skylion007/openwebtext, train[10000:10200] (held out from SAE training, but used for candidate selection - not the final untouched benchmark set)
config.zero_strength_sanity_check: Verified exact token-ID match against ordinary greedy generation with no hook for every candidate

candidates.activation_dose_response: Confirmed: mean post-steering activation rose from ~0.08 (baseline) to ~2.6 (10x strength) across prompts
candidates.output_effect: No military/Naval vocabulary appeared in generated text at any strength; outputs remained generic and largely unchanged in theme

candidates.activation_dose_response: Confirmed: mean post-steering activation rose from ~0.08 (baseline) to ~2.3 (10x strength) across prompts
candidates.output_effect: No book/reading-related vocabulary appeared in generated text at any strength

candidates.provisional_concept: URL/contact structural tokens (fires on '.', '://', '@' within URLs, not on domain words)
candidates.activation_dose_response: Confirmed: mean post-steering activation rose from ~0.04 (baseline) to ~2.3 (10x strength) across prompts
candidates.output_effect: No URL-like structure appeared in generated text at strengths 3x-10x under last-position steering

candidates.activation_dose_response: Confirmed: mean post-steering activation rose from ~0.05 (baseline) to ~2.4 (10x strength) across prompts
candidates.output_effect: The literal token 'Mr' did not appear more frequently in generated text at any strength

candidates.provisional_concept: lexical control: ' think' (invalidated - one prompt already contains 'think', confounding the control)
candidates.activation_dose_response: Confirmed: mean post-steering activation rose from ~0.11 (baseline) to ~2.5 (10x strength) across prompts
candidates.output_effect: Not usable as a clean control; excluded from final interpretation

finding: Across all 5 candidates - including clean, single-token lexical controls expected to be maximally steerable - additive decoder-direction steering reliably raised the targeted feature's activation, but no candidate produced its corresponding concept or token in generated output under last-position-only intervention.
next_step: Feature #1046 dropped as an invalid control; #3574, #754, and #727 carried forward to persistent (all-position) steering with a matched random-direction control (see steering_persistent.json)
